newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila share index up 1.92 pct on technical buying.
newsitem.headline: Manila share index up 1.92 pct on technical buying.

text.p: Heavy accumulation in index heavyweights and property issues boosted the Philippine composite index higher at close on Wednesday, brokers said.
The composite index rose 56.14, or 1.92 percent, to close at 2,983.57, breaking the continuous downtrend since the start of the month.
"This is a just a technical rebound," Joey Roxas, president of Eagle Equities said.
